7.en: She gave a humble answer when the team praised her work.
7.zh: 团队称赞她的工作时，她谦虚地回应了。

10.en: The sudden silence rendered the room uncomfortable.
10.zh: 突然的安静让房间里的气氛变得不自在。

16.en: Each individual student gets feedback on the project.
16.zh: 每位学生都会收到关于项目的反馈。

25.en: Children often inherit traits from both parents.
25.zh: 孩子常常会从父母双方遗传到特征。

28.en: Online banking has become mainstream in many countries.
28.zh: 网上银行在许多国家已经成为主流。

39.en: The old building vanished behind a cloud of dust.
39.zh: 那栋旧楼消失在一片尘土之后。

40.en: A new problem emerged during the meeting.
40.zh: 会议期间出现了一个新问题。

47.en: Most people are not immune to the flu.
47.zh: 大多数人都无法对流感免疫。

49.en: The two stories show a clear parallel.
49.zh: 这两个故事展现出明显的相似之处。

50.en: It is a paradox that the busiest people often have the least free time.
50.zh: 忙碌的人往往空闲时间最少，这是一种矛盾现象。

53.en: The latest software update fixed a bug in the login page.
53.zh: 最新的软件更新修复了登录页面的一个故障。

58.en: The dog chased the ball across the yard.
